rules.rule: Reports only: no source edit, no fix, no plan file
must: it edits no source, applies no fix, and writes no plan

rules.rule: style runs only through review, never as its own worker
must: `style` is never a\s+dimension or a worker of its own

rules.rule: The running app's UX and speed are not dispatched; the report names web:improve and web:perf as the next step
must: The running app's UX and speed are not audited

rules.rule: No target audits the working diff; `all` audits the whole frontend
must: empty — the files under the root that the working diff touches
`all` — the whole frontend

rules.rule: Broad target with no budget: propose and stop before dispatch
must: switches to `plan_first`
Nothing is dispatched before the answer

rules.rule: The audit splits all work; no worker fans out
must: A subagent cannot dispatch subagents, so the audit splits all the work and no worker fans out

rules.rule: Exactly one review worker runs the contract check, named in its brief
must: Its brief says so; no other brief does

rules.rule: cover, doc, and e2e grade Should-fix or Nit, never Blocker
must: `cover`, `doc`, and `e2e` never grade a Blocker
Nit when only statement lines are uncovered

rules.rule: A route no spec reaches, or an undriven control that writes or recovers, is Should-fix; other undriven controls are Nit
must: Should-fix when no spec reaches it, or a\s+control no spec drives writes data or recovers from an error
Nit when no undriven control\s+does either

rules.rule: One finding per concern across dimensions; the measuring dimension owns it
must: same concern is one finding, naming both dimensions
skill fixes that concern owns it: its grade, its command, its fix-order slot
is `cover`'s, which measured it
Cap at `max` after deduplicating

rules.rule: Fix order is dependency order, not severity
must: Dependency order, not severity

rules.rule: Counts read off the finished report
must: Read every count off the finished report
Report tersely: no preamble or narration
